name: secrets-manager
title: Secrets Manager
description: Store API keys, tokens and passwords in an encrypted local file. AES-256-GCM, key in the macOS Keychain, organized with nested folders and tags.
author: cyber-eternal

commands.name: manage-secrets
commands.title: Manage Secrets
commands.description: Browse secrets by folder, copy, edit, retag, move and delete

commands.name: search-secrets
commands.title: Search Secrets
commands.description: Search every secret by name, tag or folder and copy its value

commands.name: add-secret
commands.title: Add Secret
commands.description: Save a new secret with a folder and tags

commands.name: export-secrets
commands.title: Export Secrets
commands.description: Export the vault as a passphrase-encrypted file or plain JSON

commands.name: import-secrets
commands.title: Import Secrets
commands.description: Import secrets from a previously exported file

commands.name: daily-backup
commands.title: Daily Backup
commands.description: Background job that snapshots the encrypted vault once a day

preferences.name: enableBackups
preferences.title: Backups
preferences.label: Enable automatic backups after each change
preferences.description: Write a timestamped encrypted backup after every change

preferences.name: backupDir
preferences.title: Backup Folder
preferences.description: Where to write backups. Defaults to the extension's support folder.

preferences.name: retention
preferences.title: Backup Retention
preferences.description: How many backups to keep before pruning the oldest

preferences.name: dailyBackup
preferences.title: Daily Backup
preferences.label: Enable daily scheduled backup
preferences.description: Take one background snapshot per day

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
